Trading volume is subdued at 0.78x the 5-day average, requiring confirmation of direction.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (83,115 KRW) above SMA5 (82,477 KRW), below SMA20 (87,140 KRW) and SMA50 (98,539 KRW): short-term trend weak, medium-term trend showing downward bias
· Significantly below SMA100 (106,000 KRW) and SMA200 (101,409 KRW): deepening long-term downtrend
· 52-week position (29.6%): approaching historical low levels
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.1 → 39.3): attempting to exit oversold territory, recovery to neutral zone is key
· MACD histogram trajectory (-335.1573 → 79.7573): improvement observed from negative territory, exploring potential trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Bands current price position (near lower band 78,132 KRW): approaching lower band, band width at 20.67% suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (83,045 KRW): close to current price, support strength needs confirmation
· Swing resistance (89,580 KRW): first resistance zone on short-term rebound
· 5-day high (86,835 KRW) / 5-day low (78,000 KRW): suggesting potential formation of a Higher Low pattern
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x): subdued volume, reducing confidence in directional confirmation
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI oversold exit attempt and MACD improvement are positive, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to directional uncertainty from lack of volume
